note: Fictional sample benchmarks for a course exercise. Not real market data.

entries.answer: About 340,000 teams of two to fifteen people use a shared inbox or help desk, growing 11 percent a year. Typical price is 19 to 39 dollars per user per month.

Open-item trackers are crowded at the low end: free tiers cover teams of five, and paid plans sit at 8 to 15 dollars per user. Differentiation comes from reading notes automatically, not from the tracker itself.
In a survey of 120 small teams, 58 percent said they re-answer questions because they cannot find an earlier reply. 34 percent said they would pay extra for search by meaning.
Owners of teams under 15 resist per-user price jumps. Flat pricing up to 15 users tested 22 percent better on trial-to-paid conversion than per-user tiers.
